name: M1 -> testWeekIndex is off by one: the week holding the start is counted as week 0. A Mon 2026-09-21 start with a Mon 2026-10-19 test pins a 4-week program and the test lands one week after the block ends
anchor: return Math.floor(days / 7) + 1;   // week 1 is the week holding the start
replacement: return Math.floor(days / 7);   // week 1 is the week holding the start

name: M2 -> the second taper formula gets its tw-4 clamp back (V206). Nothing at six weeks or more moves, which is why B6-B11 stay green, but every block under six weeks labels Taper on a long run that never dips: tw5 prints 4.5 mi under a Taper label in week 4
anchor: const taperWeeks = taperWeeksFor(goalId !== 'run_base' && eventTargeted, false, totalWeeks);
replacement: const taperWeeks = (goalId !== 'run_base' && eventTargeted) ? Math.min(Math.max(2, Math.round(totalWeeks * 0.12)), totalWeeks - 4) : 0;
note: NAMED TRIP: the dip rows T1c-T5c go red (tw5 dips [5] against the window [4,5]; tw1-tw4 dip nowhere), the hand series T1a-T5a go red, and T1f/T2f go red because the long run no longer sits below B. T6-T8 and B stay green. EXPECTED: T1a-T5a, T1c-T5c, T1f, T2f.

name: M4 -> the writer reads the raw wizard start instead of the RESOLVED start. A Sunday start with Sunday rest snaps to the next Monday (D25), so the stored program starts a week after the Monday the pin counted from and the test lands in week 4 of a 5-week block
note: NAMED TRIP: G5 goes red (stored _testWeek 5 and a 5-week program, want 4 from Mon 2026-09-28). Every Monday-start row agrees with the raw field and stays green, which is what isolates the resolved-start claim to G5. EXPECTED: G5 only.

note: NAMED TRIP: G2 goes red (stored _testWeek 5 on an undated 11-week build), and G3, G4, G6, G7 go red the same way. G1 and G5 set the pin and stay green. EXPECTED: G2 G3 G4 G6 G7.

name: M11 (slice B, builder) -> the INT fallback is removed: the trial skips from the CHI straight to the long LSD. A three-run block at one or two weeks still deals the INT, so its test week prints no trial at all and keeps the INT (re-anchored at slice E: the hierarchy line replaced the CHI/INT line it first named)
note: NAMED TRIP: D8a and D8b go red (the three-run tw 1-2 week draws the trial from its long LSD, so the INT survives on Mon and one LSD is lost). Every four-run fixture has a CHI and stays green. EXPECTED: D8a D8b only. At ia-version >= 213 (D113a) the tw 1-2 fixture deals INT + CHI + long and the trial takes the CHI, so D8a/D8b never reach the INT fallback; the named trip there is D8c and D8d, the spacer calendar Mon/Tue/Wed whose fallback week still deals easy / INT / long: the INT survives on Mon. EXPECTED at >= 213: D8c D8d only.
